zh.title: 烏克蘭公開Magura MV11無人母艦
zh.summary: Magura MV11公開亮相；可搭載與釋放無人機
body: 烏克蘭在獨立日無人系統遊行中公開新型Magura MV11無人水面載具，該載具由UFORCE研製，設計上作為海上母艦，可搭載與釋放其他無人機。
UFORCE表示，MV11全長最多12公尺，酬載能力達2,200公斤，續航力可達7天，航程超過2,000海里；公司將其描述為遠洋航行載具，而非近岸無人水面載具。
在公布的配置中，MV11可搭載18枚Sting無人攔截機；Sting由烏克蘭Wild Hornets研發，為電力驅動的四軸飛行器，主要用於攔截自殺式無人機。

en.title: Ukraine Unveils Magura MV11 Unmanned Surface Mothership
en.summary: Magura MV11 USV unveiled; can carry and launch drones, 2,200kg payload
body: Ukraine unveiled the Magura MV11, an unmanned surface vessel developed by UFORCE, during an Independence Day unmanned systems parade in Kyiv on August 24, according to Aerospace Global News.

The company says MV11 is designed primarily as a carrier and transport platform, with a payload of up to 2,200 kg and endurance of as much as seven days. It can deliver and launch aerial and other unmanned systems at sea.

The MV11 was displayed carrying 18 Sting aerial interceptors in individual box launchers. The Sting is an electrically powered quadcopter developed by Ukraine's Wild Hornets, intended primarily to intercept one-way attack drones.

zh.title: 中國測試波音747長空中氣體發電原型機
zh.summary: 中國完成S4000氦氣空中氣體發電原型機飛行測試；最大運行高度4,000公尺
body: 中國於西北地區完成S4000氦氣空中氣體發電原型機(SAWES)之全過程飛行測試，涵蓋爬升、定點保持、發電測試與順利回收，所有指標均符合標準。
據報導，該項測試標誌著中國高空發電技術的新突破，並驗證了該系統在複雜極端高空環境下的可靠性。
S4000型號為升級版S2000氦氣空中氣體發電系統，最大運行高度可達4,000公尺，適用於中國絕大多數地區部署。
S4000採用新配置，搭載地面站與氦氣空中氣體及連接導電鏈結的風力發電機組。

en.title: China tests Boeing 747-length airship airborne wind turbine at 4,000 metres
en.summary: China completed full-process flight test of S4000 helium airship airborne wind turbine; max altitude 4,000 metres
body: China has completed a full-process flight test of its S4000 helium airship airborne wind turbine (SAWES) at a base in Northwest China, covering ascent, station-keeping, power generation testing, and smooth recovery, with all indicators meeting required standards.

State-run outlet Global Times reported the test marks a new breakthrough in China's high-altitude wind power technology and verifies the system's reliability in complex and extreme high-altitude environments.
The S4000 is an upgraded version of the earlier S2000 SAWES, which flew to 2,000 metres and generated electricity, feeding 385 kWh into the power grid.

The S4000 adopts a new configuration with improved overall performance, with a maximum operational altitude of up to 4,000 metres, making it suitable for deployment in the vast majority of regions across China.
The Chinese system consists of a ground station and a helium airship with turbines connected by a conductive tether.
